streamingCandidate: Call unchanged Candidate A policy on completed prefix plus actual next OPEN-only carrier (neutral h=0,c=2, never observational data). The carrier cannot arm or signal; only an already completed preceding signal can exit at this OPEN. No current HIGH/CLOSE supplied. Assert stream status/time/net parity against all frozen R13 fills after allocation.
valuation: Preserve exact timestamp completed-close marks only (plus current new Entry mark). No carry-forward for off-grid Entry sizing. Unknown current equity rejects EQUAL; ONE_LOT may use actual cash. No knownMark drawdown labeled full MDD.
missing: First missing expected bar before exit permanently censors position; purchase capital and quantity stay locked, no synthetic EOD liquidation or future cash release. Full portfolio equity/return/MDD null when exposure or required mark history is unpriced.
allocationIsolation: Pure allocator sees current Entry identity/time/price/calendar, current public symbol occupancy, cash, current known equity only. Saved EXIT outcomes evaluated only after all allocation decisions; they never select the primary cohort.
otherArms: Rank/risk/adaptive not measured and not replaced by equal: no compatible causal score/risk contract introduced.
outputs: Full causal decision/closed/unresolved/equity ledgers plus explicit summary nulls, cash/lot reconciliation, concentration, Run A/B byte reproducibility. No automatic Entry winner.
